timing_definitions.training_seconds: Cumulative synchronized collection+update loop; excludes startup and I/O.
timing_definitions.process_seconds: Subprocess wall including imports, setup, training, final audit and shutdown.
timing_definitions.learn_seconds: Native learn wall: initial checkpoint, preparation, loop and I/O.
timing_definitions.loop_seconds: Native synchronized collection+update iteration wall, including first compilation.
timing_definitions.learn_overhead_seconds: learn_seconds - loop_seconds - prepare_seconds; includes in-learn I/O.
timing_definitions.checkpoint_seconds: All native save calls, including explicit final save outside learn_seconds.
timing_definitions.first_policy_call_seconds: First ready training actor call, already included in loop_seconds.
timing_definitions.first_update_group_seconds: First pair of replay updates, already included in loop_seconds.
